name: Baseline integrity
outcome: Read existing Python source, freeze tests and hashes
public_proof: Reproducible offline gate and redacted actual replay
guardrail: No frontend rewrite until baseline is anchored
gate: check offline gate and exact source SHA

name: Public Guided Experience
outcome: Next.js keyless home, five real recorded case walkthroughs
public_proof: Visitor understands verified case in three minutes
gate: trace references source IDs and accessibility E2E passes

name: Editable Scenario Lab
outcome: Isolated event-sourced branches, mutation preview, deterministic projector
public_proof: Visitor changes one scenario and sees evidence-consistent diff
guardrail: No direct writes to base data

name: Live BYOK and Provider Registry
outcome: Ephemeral provider credentials, tested tool models and bounded runs
public_proof: Visitor safely runs real agent and inspects costs
gate: secret redaction and provider E2E passes

name: Evaluation and Model Arena
outcome: Paired A/B/C evals, verifier lab, real error cohorts and costs
public_proof: Public benchmark exposes failures and limitations

name: Reliability and Portfolio Delivery
outcome: Static fallback, accessibility, performance, documentation, video
public_proof: Public demo reliably serves job/interview audience

name: Bounded Specialist Experiment
outcome: Add optional multiagent D topology with deliberate budget
public_proof: Demonstrate actual D vs C comparison
gate: cost/risk/quality comparisons prove or disprove benefit

name: Failure and Robustness Studio
outcome: Tool errors, injected data, provider outages and self-test library
public_proof: Visitor safely reproduces failure and defensive response
gate: attack tests and policy isolation pass

name: Evidence and Temporal Knowledge
outcome: Evidence graph, strict citations and policy versions
public_proof: Every claim backtracks to exact versioned origin
guardrail: Do not infer causal truth from link graph

name: Operations Economics Lab
outcome: Cost-per-correct, review cost and risk-weighted utility simulations
public_proof: Compare policies under explicit assumptions

name: Human Attention & Review OS
outcome: Review state machine, abstention, queue simulator and workload UX
public_proof: Review burden and decision quality compared
guardrail: No live approvals or real customer operations
gate: case queue and human decision audit

name: Multiagent Orchestration Studio
outcome: Supervisor, parallel graph, handoffs, critic, checkpoint visual editor
public_proof: Visitor builds a bounded graph and sees measured effects

name: Retrieval and Memory Research
outcome: Dense/BM25/hybrid, rerankers, temporal memory and poisoning lab
public_proof: Visitor compares retrieval correctness on same dataset
guardrail: No PII or unsupervised memory self-training

name: Agent Security and Red Team Lab
outcome: OWASP-aligned canned attacks, MCP safety and identity checks
public_proof: Demonstrate bounded tool and memory trust
gate: unsafe actions denied, failed attacks documented

name: Protocols and External Specialists
outcome: MCP resources/tools, A2A simulated partner, signed evidence contracts
public_proof: Interoperable scoped external-agent mock

name: Inference Routing & FinOps
outcome: Multi-provider adapters, routing decisions, quality/cost frontier
public_proof: Find model strategy minimizing cost per correct at target quality
gate: paired vendor conformance and pricing timestamps

name: Durable Agent Operations
outcome: Long-running workloads, health, tracing, cancellation, recovery, runbooks
public_proof: Interrupt and resume a complex run reliably
guardrail: No task duplication or state corruption
gate: chaos/recovery tests, p95 and SLO results

name: Simulation Digital Twin
outcome: Scale simulated payment operations, faults, workload, multi-actor incentives
public_proof: Explore realistic pressure scenarios with declared assumptions
guardrail: Never call simulation a real bank

name: Multimodal Document Intelligence
outcome: Synthetic statements, PDFs, images, voice, OCR source-grounded extraction
public_proof: Inspect extraction/grounding failures via screenshots

name: Causal & Counterfactual Studio
outcome: Structural assumptions, interventions, policy/FX alternate worlds
public_proof: Separate correlation from counterfactual mechanisms

name: Continuous Evals & Learning Science
outcome: Review feedback, active learning, calibration and small models
public_proof: Failure-to-regression compounding loop

name: Developer Platform & Tool SDK
outcome: Python CLI, typed TS clients, API/MCP and reproducible case packs
public_proof: Any developer can rerun and inspect via headless tools
guardrail: No public mutation of finance systems

name: Distribution & Career Signal Engine
outcome: Public case-study exports, demos, essays, sources, contributor UX
public_proof: Independent engineers can verify and share work
guardrail: No vanity claims or fake endorsements

name: Open Research Horizons
outcome: Neuro-symbolic, causal, local models, formal methods, federation and new agent paradigms
public_proof: New research streams added continuously with gates
guardrail: No promise of exhaustive future tech coverage
gate: per-topic reproducible result and safety review
